mapper.sql: select id, project_no, title, description, cover_image, images, video_url, tags, creator_user_id, creator_name, creator_avatar, manufacturer_user_id, manufacturer_name, manufacturer_avatar, proofing_invitation_id, base_price, tiered_pricing, validity_days, status, production_status, delivery_status, view_count, favorite_count, share_count, manufacturer_photos, manufacturer_upload_time, total_sales_amount, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sd_presale_project
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.project_no, p.title, p.description, p.cover_image, p.images, p.video_url, p.tags, p.creator_user_id, p.creator_name, p.creator_avatar, p.manufacturer_user_id, p.manufacturer_name, p.manufacturer_avatar, p.proofing_invitation_id, p.base_price, p.tiered_pricing, p.validity_days, p.status, p.production_status, p.delivery_status, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.share_count, p.manufacturer_photos, p.manufacturer_upload_time, p.total_sales_amount, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, -- 关联查询发起人信息 creator.nick_name as creator_nick_name, creator.avatar as creator_avatar_url, -- 关联查询厂家信息 manufacturer.nick_name as manufacturer_nick_name, manufacturer.avatar as manufacturer_avatar_url FROM sd_presale_project p LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON p.creator_user_id = creator.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user manufacturer ON p.manufacturer_user_id = manufacturer.user_id
AND p.status = #{status}
AND (p.validity_days IS NULL OR p.create_time IS NULL OR DATE_ADD(p.create_time, INTERVAL p.validity_days DAY) > NOW())
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
